findings.text: _wipe now deletes every StandardNameChange node in the session-scoped disposable graph (conftest.py:613 describes it as 'the one empty graph this package's real-Cypher tests share'), so a module-scoped receipt another test file seeded can be destroyed when this file's tests interleave with it in one -n 8 worker; the reset is correct for this file but its blast radius is the whole ledger.

The dead-end-revival exception in the same lock query still tests b.source_type, the exact batch field this node established is absent from worker outcomes; it is latent because persist_claimed_attachments passes allow_dead_end_revival=False, but the same clause-level defect survives one caller away in the query the node edited.

Nineteen of the twenty-one cases the head graph arm runs already pass against main (attachment-base-graph.log, 2 failed/19 passed), including test_two_path_projection_stub_is_adopted at :271 and test_structural_parent_projection_stub_is_adopted at :285, so the done_when's 'the new cases fail on main' is met by two cases only; the fragment states this accurately but the measure itself reads as met.

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_compose_adopts_pending_stub.py:215 reddens with the answering commit reversed (attachment-negative.log, EXIT=1) and :303 reddens on c59ac227a while passing at head, so both repaired defects carry a test that fails if the repair regresses, and :536 keeps the stolen-claim abort independent of them.
justifications.evidence: The gate measures the done_when's zero-added-id half on both arms with completed archive-tree logs (attachment-base-default.log and attachment-head-default.log, 10 failed each, identical ids), but attachment-base-graph.log records 19 of 21 delivered cases passing on main, so the bullet 'the new cases fail on main' is measured as true for only test_worker_attachment_uses_the_graph_source_type[False] and test_second_claim_after_unpark_finalizes.
justifications.fit: The added symbols (_pending_projection_stub_predicate, _projection_migration_predicate, _projection_stub_source_bindings) name the mechanism, explain their trusted-Cypher arguments, follow the surrounding guard style at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_source_bindings.py:921, and every commit carries a conventional subject with a body and no attribution trailer.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_source_bindings.py:904 now reads {source}.source_type from the fenced graph node, which the pointed live probe shows is the only place the seven DD paths of the five pending names carry the type, so the worker attachment that brief.md:35-41 describes now adopts.
justifications.reuse: imas_codex/standard_names/provenance_lifecycle.py:505 delegates to the binding owner's predicate at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_source_bindings.py:883 and appends only migration-specific retirement fences, replacing the duplicate _UNOWNED_PENDING_PROJECTION that the prior review scored for capability duplication.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff c59ac227a..f61326d28 changes only graph_catalog.py, graph_source_bindings.py, graph_supersession.py, provenance_lifecycle.py, tests/standard_names/test_compose_adopts_pending_stub.py and the assigned fragment, every one of them inside the manifest's declared write paths.
